CitationAnchor.description:
A page-local Docling provenance target.

Coordinates use a normalized top-left origin so every client can draw the
highlight without knowing Docling's coordinate convention or PDF page size.
CitationAnchor.title: CitationAnchor

ClaimSupportSpan.description: Exact, chunk-relative source span used to support one atomic claim.
ClaimSupportSpan.title: ClaimSupportSpan

HardwareBenchmark.description: Recorded result of an explicitly requested, download-free local probe.
HardwareBenchmark.title: HardwareBenchmark

HardwareBenchmarkRequest.description: Explicit consent to benchmark already installed models; never pulls weights.
HardwareBenchmarkRequest.title: HardwareBenchmarkRequest

HardwareProfile.description: Legacy catalog profile kept for API and TUI compatibility.
HardwareProfile.title: HardwareProfile

HardwareProfileView.description: Compact V1.1 wire view consumed by the Rust setup screen.

HardwareScanRequest.description: Read-only hardware discovery; ``force`` bypasses an application cache.
HardwareScanRequest.title: HardwareScanRequest

IndexingOptions.description:
Safe, versioned controls for the public book indexing pipeline.

Parser thresholds deliberately stay server-owned so a workspace cannot
accidentally create an index that is incompatible with its generation.
IndexingOptions.title: IndexingOptions

MediaAsset.description:
One page-local visual with stable source and crop provenance.

A MediaAsset is not itself textual evidence. ``nearby_text`` only links back
to existing EvidenceRecords, while ``derived_text`` is routing metadata and
must never be promoted to a factual text citation without human review.
MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset

MediaEvidence.description: Rust/App-compatible query result; never a textual EvidenceRecord.
MediaEvidence.title: MediaEvidence

MediaText.description: Text attached to a visual with an explicit, non-interchangeable origin.
MediaText.title: MediaText

ModelProfileApplyAndReindexRequest.description: Consent envelope for an embedding-changing, staged profile rebuild.
ModelProfileApplyAndReindexRequest.title: ModelProfileApplyAndReindexRequest

ModelProfileApplyRequest.description: Consent envelope for the mutations described by a prior preflight.
ModelProfileApplyRequest.title: ModelProfileApplyRequest

ModelProfilePreflightRequest.description: Preview a profile without downloads, config writes or reindexing.
ModelProfilePreflightRequest.title: ModelProfilePreflightRequest

NormalizedMediaBBox.description: Top-left-origin page coordinates shared by Core, API clients and crops.
NormalizedMediaBBox.title: NormalizedMediaBBox

OKFMediaProposal.description: OKF 0.2-compatible proposal; persistence belongs to OmaWiki.
OKFMediaProposal.title: OKFMediaProposal

PerformanceProfile.description: User-facing V1.1 behavior profile with legacy input aliases.
PerformanceProfile.title: PerformanceProfile

PrivacyPolicy.description: Fail-closed policy for HTTP requests that can carry private content.
PrivacyPolicy.title: PrivacyPolicy

RetentionPolicy.description: Workspace history limits; indefinite legacy retention needs explicit opt-in.
RetentionPolicy.title: RetentionPolicy

RunReceipt.description: Small, user-facing account of how an answer was produced.
